newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end lower, off day's high.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end lower, off day's high.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended lower on Wednesday on profit-taking, dealers said.

The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index ended 1.54 points, or 0.09 percent, lower at 1,741.99, after rising to 1,756.17 in early trading. Gainers led losers 193 to 153 as turnover rose to 56.6 million shares from Tuesday's 50.2 million.

Profit-taking at midday pulled down the index, one dealer said. "PTCL, which carries a heavy weight on the index, has shedded weight in the past four sessions after the flotation of PTCL-related bonds abroad."
"The core investment stocks such as Pakistan State Oil (PSO), Shell Pakistan and Engro, continued the upward journey and closed further higher," the dealer said.
PTCL fell 1.20 rupees to 30.30, Wyeth Lab 4.00 to 150 and Philips 2.00 to 81. PSO rose 3.00 to 320, Shell 10 to 210, Engro 6.50 to 194, ICI 0.50 to 28.20 and HUBCO 0.05 to 41.55.
